The '''Waygate''' is an area located at the [[Shaper's Terrace]] in the [[Un'Goro Crater]]. It is devoid of NPCs.

==Trivia==
* The Waygate and the Shaper's Terrace were formerly home to the [[Keepers of Outerend]], who were removed in an unknown update.
